best_idea: Use a 4-row register-blocking approach with NEON intrinsics to increase arithmetic intensity and minimize the number of loads/stores of C by keeping 4 rows of C in NEON registers.

best_lineage.idea: Change the loop order from i-j-k to i-k-j to enable contiguous memory access for B and C, improving cache locality and allowing the compiler to auto-vectorize the inner loop.
